claims.head: Anaheim pounces on mistakes, and Calgary makes them
claims.body: Anaheim ranks 6th of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.7% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Calgary ranks 30th for avoiding breakdowns.

claims.head: Shots should fly both ways
claims.body: Calgary’s games average 85.9 unblocked shots per 60 at 5-on-5, both teams combined (3rd of 32 for pace); Anaheim’s average 86.1 (2nd).
